description: This source file implements ubus (micro bus) support for hostapd, including functions for managing ubus connections, handling events, managing BSS interfaces, and interacting with clients and neighbor reports within the hostapd Wi-Fi access point software.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_add_bss
methods.description: Registers a new ubus object for a hostapd BSS interface, enabling ubus communication.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_free_bss
methods.description: Removes the ubus object associated with a hostapd BSS interface.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_handle_event
methods.description: Handles ubus events such as probe, auth, and assoc requests, and sends notifications.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_notify
methods.description: Sends a ubus notification for a specific client address and event type.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_add_iface
methods.description: Initializes ubus support for a hostapd interface.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_free_iface
methods.description: Cleans up ubus support for a hostapd interface.
